items.observable_condition: the web prototype computes and displays an assessment produced from governed content, end to end, at least once
the same input, evaluated twice against the same release, produces byte-identical facts - which requires a release to exist
each finding in a produced report resolves to a governed evidence record
coverage is computed over governed content and rendered as its own axis, never folded into a risk value
three independent version identifiers exist for one running system, and a rollback between two released versions has been executed
the validation case store holds at least fifty authored cases
a holdout set exists and the separation audit shows no case in it influenced rule development
a continuous integration provider has executed the safety gate and recorded every invariant passing
the protocol carries a signatory and at least one blind-first review is recorded complete
a completed review records that the reviewer used the interactive workflow
at least one metric has a computed value attributed to a named release
governed audit events exist in a real store and the hash chain verifies
a staging environment has been deployed, its health endpoint observed answering, and a reliability report produced from executed drills
every registered claim names required evidence, and each named item resolves to an artifact present in the repository
the representative demonstration runs to completion offline, with the language model disabled and every P1 feature off, and produces a result rather than an empty state

note: An item becomes satisfied when its observable condition is observed. Writing 15 here would not satisfy anything.
